summary: Massachusetts General Hospital is conducting a Phase 2 clinical trial titled NCT05933499 to study adults with obesity. The trial tests combinations of the study drugs tirzepatide and bimagrumab, along with lifestyle and nutrition counseling, to see how they affect body composition. A target of 63 participants are taking part in this recruiting study. The research looks closely at changes in lean muscle mass, fat, and bone health over a period of 52 weeks.
